Founding Backend Engineer

Remote (US/EU) · Full-time · $150k-$190k + meaningful equity

About us

Anvil & Cloud is a 6-person team building developer-experience tooling for embedded systems engineers. We're funded by top-tier seed investors and have 14 paying customers in early access.

About the role

You'll be the second engineer at Anvil & Cloud and the first backend hire. You'll own everything from API design to the core compilation pipeline. We expect you to be hands-on at every layer of the stack.

What you'll do (in your first 6 months)

  • Ship our core API in Rust + Axum
  • Stand up our compilation pipeline (LLVM-based) on Kubernetes
  • Design the data model in Postgres and our caching layer in Redis
  • Set up our CI/CD pipeline and observability stack from scratch
  • Be on-call alongside the founding team for our 14 early customers

Who you are

  • 3+ years of backend engineering experience
  • Comfortable in Rust (or willing to ramp up quickly with mentorship)
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL, Redis, and Kubernetes
  • You've worked at a startup (under 30 people) for at least 1 year
  • You write tests, own outcomes, and ship

Bonus

  • Background in compilers, embedded systems, or developer tooling
  • Open-source contributions, especially Rust ecosystem

Compensation

$150,000 - $190,000 base + 0.4% - 1.2% equity, vesting over 4 years. We can support remote work anywhere in US or EU timezones.
